definition.title: Pass through Ashwing Grove
definition.briefing: The Court guards the last unburned timber between Hearth and the eastern roads. Its wardens prefer an agreement that keeps armies out of the grove, but will fight anyone cutting a new military road. Hold the wooded clearing and protect the defenders from attacks along both trade paths. Move the commander to the eastern exit while the treaty protects the detachment.
definition.failureText: The detachment could not complete its mission.

objectives.text: Reach the eastern exit under treaty protection.

actions.text: The truce grants passage for 30 seconds.
The truce has expired. The garrison is hostile again.
